_comment: The new cups' arenas, in cup order (cup 23 onwards). Each entry describes the pictures the image generator makes for it: floor, round medallion at the centre of the floor, low wall round the floor, the tall backdrop round the arena (its top rows also make the dark vault above), pillar face (not used by the model: the bracket camera sweeps through any pillar). Floor and medallion are smooth on purpose: one continuous mottled surface and one big plain shape, with no tiles, joints or thin lines, which shimmer and zigzag at the game's resolution. Everything static and matte: no fire, water, smoke, glow, cloth or lettering.

arenas.name: rookie
arenas.setting: a simple village training yard
arenas.floor: one continuous surface of packed earth, light tan with soft slightly lighter and darker tan blotches; no tiles, joints or lines
arenas.medallion: a smooth round disc: one big plain five-pointed star in pale cream on a field of light tan earth, inside one broad plain band at the edge
arenas.wall: a low solid barrier of raw pale wooden planks laid horizontally and nailed to thick posts, with a flat rail on top
arenas.backdrop: a tall stockade of raw pale timber logs standing side by side, with simple wooden walkways and ladders across it, pale tan earth at its foot, the top of the logs cut to points
arenas.pillar: the surface of a thick post of raw pale wood seen close up, its vertical grain and knots clear, with simple rope bands

arenas.name: champion

arenas.floor: one continuous surface of worn travertine, warm beige with soft pale sand and slightly darker beige blotches; no tiles, joints or lines
arenas.medallion: a smooth round disc: one big plain laurel wreath ring in pale sand on a field of warm beige stone, inside one broad plain band at the edge
arenas.wall: dressed blocks of warm beige travertine with a plain projecting cornice on top
arenas.backdrop: the tiered seating of a coliseum seen from the arena: rows of round arches stacked in three tiers of warm beige travertine, the arch openings in shadow, empty of people
arenas.pillar: a fluted classical column shaft of warm beige travertine
